paper_title: Light Dark Matter Search with Ionization Signals in XENON1T
notes: Paper constrains absorption of dark photons (kinetic mixing kappa, panel F) and axion-like particles (g_ae, panel E) for masses 0.186-1 keV, plus DM-nucleus/electron scattering. For dark photons, Table I gives one explicit point: m=0.5 keV, kappa=2.2e-16 at 90% CL. The exclusion curve (panel F) spans ~0.2-5 keV with kappa from ~1e-16 to ~1e-14 but only the tabulated point has a precise numerical value. Note: the paper ALSO constrains ALPs via g_ae (AxionElectron, g_ae=7.7e-14 at 0.5 keV); coupling type is ambiguous between DarkPhoton and AxionElectron. Hint and table both support DarkPhoton extraction here. Standard local DM density (0.3 GeV/cm^3) assumed for absorption signal. | Vision: Calibration given was for panel A (cross-section). Requested coupling is DarkPhoton (panel F). Panel F x-axis is 0.2-5 keV/c^2 (2e2 to 5e3 eV), y-axis right side is kinetic mixing kappa (1e-16 to 1e-14). Traced the XENON1T (this work) black lower boundary. Anchored to Table I value kappa=2.2e-16 at m=0.5 keV. The dark photon limit shows a notable dip near 0.7 keV. | Calibration: No calibration needed
